rationale: The functional assay method described (Southern blotting) is inappropriate for assessing LDL receptor function as it is a genotyping tool, not a functional assay. No experimental controls (wild-type or pathogenic) or replicates are documented.
experimental_details: Southern blotting was used to identify deletions in the LDL receptor gene. No functional assays measuring LDL receptor activity (e.g., LDL uptake assays) were performed.
reason_if_not_applicable: Functional assay method is inappropriate—Southern blotting is a genotyping tool, not a functional assay. No experimental controls (wild-type, pathogenic, or positive controls) are present. No replicates (biological or technical) are documented.
